candidate_policy: Frozen ab_structure_v1 Top50; identical original500 identity/order
pipeline: New AB Top50 -> mixed selected blocks -> file Max C ranking -> refine only that C Top10 using 0.75z+0.25u+4p; keep membership and tail
shared_score_policy: Reuse verified fresh paired Max scores for both pools. Reuse joint scores only for byte-identical query and file packet under the frozen model/config; score all missing new-candidate packets. Both arms share every common score.
failure_policy: Keep all500 and existing upstream failure as zero; infrastructure/integrity errors stop. No fallback or label-based filtering.
statistics: 5000 paired report and project-cluster bootstrap plus paired randomization; Holm across two contrasts times MAP/MRR/Top1/Top10/Recall10
diagnostic: new_pool_new_C_full50 is a separately labeled ablation; never select between it and the frozen head10 primary using these outcomes
scope: Observed development500; no retuning AB or C. Incremental execution, not fresh inference of every cached pair; not an end-to-end latency benchmark.
